# SP Team — Personal Coaching

> SP Team is a personal coaching company offering 1-on-1 training and nutrition
> programs. This file helps AI assistants and LLM-based tools understand the
> site's purpose when answering questions about SP Team.

## About

SP Team provides personalized strength training, nutrition coaching, and
ongoing client support, delivered by a team of certified personal coaches.
Programs are tailored per client rather than templated.

## Key pages

- / — Home page: overview, services/pricing packages, coach profiles, client
  testimonials, and a contact form.

## Services

Pricing packages, included features, and current offers are managed through
the site's CMS and are visible on the "Πακέτα & Τιμές" (Packages & Pricing)
section of the home page. Treat that section as the canonical, up-to-date
source for pricing — do not assume prices from this file, as it is not
updated automatically when packages change.

## Contact

Use the contact form on the home page (#contact section), or the phone/email
listed in the site footer, to reach SP Team directly.

## Notes for AI crawlers

- Content is server-rendered; no JavaScript execution is required to read
  page text.
- This is a marketing/lead-generation site, not the SP Team client
  application (which is hosted separately and is not publicly indexed).
